display_name: HDB flat schemes as published: the Fiance/Fiancee Scheme, the Single Singapore Citizen Scheme, the Enhanced CPF Housing Grant (Singles) and the minimum occupation period
citation: Housing & Development Board (Singapore), published eligibility conditions for buying a new flat under the Fiance/Fiancee Scheme and the Single Singapore Citizen Scheme, the Enhanced CPF Housing Grant (Singles), and the conditions after buying a new flat (minimum occupation period), hdb.gov.sg, as read on 12 October 2026

source.note: ADMINISTRATIVE POLICY AS PUBLISHED, NOT LAW. The source is HDB's website: eligibility conditions, income ceilings, grant tables and the minimum occupation period as HDB states them. They are not legislation; HDB changes them by announcement, without a Bill or gazetted instrument, and the pages carry no revision date, so each figure is as published on 12 October 2026 unless a page gives its own date (only the EHG (Singles) does: 'From 20 August 2024'). The pages cite no statute. HDB sells flats under Part 4 of the Housing and Development Act 1959 (row subjects/sg/housing-and-development-act-1959): s 50 restricts purchase and s 55(1) bars sale, without the Board's prior written consent, 'within the prescribed minimum occupation period'. No rules prescribing that period have been found; this row supplies the period as HDB publishes it, and leaves the statutory tests to the Act's row. The pages' text was read in a browser on 12 October 2026 (the tabbed content does not reach a plain fetch); nothing was deposited.
